title: Island Perimeter
description: Calculate the perimeter of an island represented by a grid of 1s (land) and 0s (water).
pseudocode:
1. perimeter = 0
2. for r = 0 to rows-1
3.   for c = 0 to cols-1
4.     if grid[r][c] == 1
5.       perimeter += 4
6.       if r > 0 and grid[r-1][c] == 1: perimeter -= 2
7.       if c > 0 and grid[r][c-1] == 1: perimeter -= 2

steps.note: Checking grid[0][0]. It is water (0), skip.
Found land at grid[0][1]. Add 4 to perimeter (Total: 4).
Found land at grid[1][0]. Add 4 to perimeter (Total: 8).
Found land at grid[1][1]. Add 4. Adjacent to grid[1][0] and grid[0][1], subtract 2+2 (Total: 8).
